title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease and blood pressure management.

HPI
The patient presents for follow-up of known chronic kidney disease, currently assessed as stage 3b. He reports his blood pressure remains elevated, and he continues to manage his hypertension as previously instructed. He denies any acute symptoms, including swelling, fatigue, or changes in urination since the last visit. He reports adherence to his prescribed medications.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Amlodipine 5 mg daily

Exam
Vitals: BP 148/88 mmHg. Physical exam is otherwise stable; no peripheral edema noted. Cardiovascular exam is benign. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally.

Assessment
1. Chronic Kidney Disease, stage 3b.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications: Lisinopril and Amlodipine. Reinforce dietary sodium restriction and the importance of daily blood pressure monitoring to manage hypertension. Follow up in three months or sooner if symptoms worsen.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.
CKD stage 3b: N18.32 (maps to a higher V28 HCC than 3a).

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
3a is less severe than the documented 3b.
Stage 3b is documented; do not use unspecified stage 3.
